name: oasis-code-backend
description: oasis-code: a coding harness in TypeScript on Bun — model calls, tool execution, state, permissions, history and the API are this program's

scripts.build: bun build --compile --target=bun src/index.ts src/execution/fork_watch_worker.ts src/share/live/projector_worker.ts src/agent/context_report_worker.ts --outfile dist/oasis-code && (test "$(uname -s)" != Darwin || codesign --force --sign - dist/oasis-code)
scripts.postinstall: cd ../contract && bun install --silent && cd ../backend-ts && rm -rf node_modules/@oasis-code/contract && mkdir -p node_modules/@oasis-code && ln -sfn ../../../contract node_modules/@oasis-code/contract
